documents.content: Arkan Tsabit is a Data Engineer with hands-on experience building production-ready ETL pipelines. He is certified as an Oracle Multicloud Architect, IBM Data Engineer, and Meta Database Engineer.
Arkan Tsabit has 4 major data engineering projects: BatchETL Pipeline, Uber Data Pipeline, Amazon Web Scraping, and Daily Expense Tracker.
Arkan Tsabit is proficient in Apache Airflow, PostgreSQL, DuckDB, Python, Pandas, Docker, Streamlit, Plotly, and Matplotlib.

Arkan Tsabit has 10 professional certifications: 8 from Oracle (OCI Multicloud Architect, Generative AI, AI Vector Search, Autonomous DB, Cloud DB Services, AI Foundations, Foundations, Data Platform), 1 from IBM (Data Engineering), and 1 from Meta (Database Engineer).

Arkan Tsabit's achievements include: Top 108 Global in Oracle Race to Certification 2025, Top 3 Indonesia in Oracle Race to Certification 2025, and Best Teacher Award at Satu Benih Boarding School 2025.

Arkan Tsabit transitioned from IT infrastructure and network engineering to data engineering. His previous roles include IT Terminal Service Support at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, Business Manager at BEJAGOO COFFEE & EATERY, Database Administrator at SATU BENIH BOARDING SCHOOL, and Level 2 Network Engineer at BRI SD-WAN.
Arkan Tsabit can be contacted at arkantsabit025@gmail.com or +62 81295709620. His GitHub is github.com/ArkanTsabit123 and LinkedIn is linkedin.com/in/arkan-tsabit.
